title: Pre-Export Row Scaling for Generated Mixed-Integer Programs: Mechanism Attribution and Residual-Budget Contracts

creators.name: Rodríguez Castro, Mathias
creators.affiliation: Facultad de Ingeniería, Universidad de la República, Montevideo, Uruguay

description: Research artifact for the manuscript "Pre-Export Row Scaling for Generated Mixed-Integer Programs: Mechanism Attribution and Residual-Budget Contracts", submitted to Mathematical Programming Computation. It contains the C++ exporter and scaling implementation, the analysis and independent verification scripts, and the stored experiment data behind every reported number: a fixed-basis conditioning audit of 306 generated dispatch models under five policies, a matrix attribution audit of 1,080 exports, a reconstruction of 240 operational solver runs with two matched sensitivity reruns, an exactly enumerated stress experiment of 4,752 optimizer calls across HiGHS, Gurobi and CPLEX with an independent re-enumeration of every verified optimum, and the residual-budget contract applied to a real dispatch model. This record corresponds to the fixed release v1.0-mpc-submission. The bulk inputs of the fixed-basis audit are deposited separately as fixed-basis-exports.tar.zst (337 MB compressed, 5.18 GB uncompressed). Source code: MIT; data and aggregate results: CC BY 4.0; the manuscript itself is not covered by those licenses. No acceptance or publication is claimed.
